title: Can I SURVIVE MORE Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess vs online humans ('lazy pink dolphin', 'lazy pink zebra'); goal 5 wins, achieved in 6 games (5-1). G1 (black) Rising Water vs opp Punching Down - W (king taken); G2 (black) Edgelord vs opp Sibling Rivalry - W (opponent times out after 4 moves); G3 Cowardly-type (when your opponent captures you must move backwards or lose - he bluffs) vs opp Forward March - W; G4 (black) Remorseful vs opp Fischer Random - L; G5 Farsighted vs opp Closed Book - W; G6 Scouting Ahead vs opp Separation of Church and State - W (flag).
rules: Standard setup and moves; each player is dealt one secret random drawback (card with Easy-Hard difficulty slider); the opponent's drawback is revealed when the game ends ('Your opponent's drawback was ...').
No check/checkmate: kings may move into or stay in attack; capturing the enemy king wins.
Breaking or failing your drawback condition makes you lose (or the move is simply illegal, depending on drawback wording).
Players may chat/rename to bluff or reveal drawbacks.

Drawbacks in this video: Rising Water - every 10 turns the water level rises one rank (from your side); you can't move pieces that are underwater or to underwater squares (shown as tinted rows). Punching Down - (text not read). Edgelord - must have at least as many pieces on the rim as your opponent. Sibling Rivalry - you cannot move a piece to a square adjacent to an opponent's piece of the same type. Cowardly - when your opponent captures, you must move backwards or lose. Forward March - (text not read; forward-only implied). Remorseful - you can't capture twice in a row. Fischer Random - on or before move 20, all your remaining non-pawn pieces must be on your home row on a square they could not have started on. Farsighted - your pieces can't capture nearby pieces. Closed Book - you lose if you ever start your turn while there's an open file. Scouting Ahead - as long as you have a pawn, you cannot move non-pawns ahead of your most advanced pawn. Separation of Church and State - you can't move your bishops next to a king and can't move your king next to a bishop.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king (or flag). Goal: 5 wins.
